title: Add DSC v3 profile resource to deploy key and shortcut remappings
author: Gijsreyn
summary: The current-head review found two author-facing issues: the profile-resource integration tests use live user settings and the production synchronization event, making them destructive and order-dependent, and the current x64 release validation is failing. Isolate the tests from the user's settings and event state, then investigate and restore a passing x64 release build before merge.
